study.question: Observed limitation: round18 continuous AUC0.6219726927 < duplicate histogram0.6221659452; round19 continuous0.6222711565 < duplicate histogram0.6225086647, despite nonzero fine-age diagnostic response. Does an explicitly bin-conditioned exact-age summary outperform the duplicate-histogram incumbent and both frozen source bests under active capacity and measured cost controls?
study.hypothesis: Provisional explanation, not established: the prior 16 group/action decay mean/second/lower-envelope summaries mix four coarse age cells and duplicate counts already available to exchangeable_joint; the lower-envelope feature also had float32 direct-oracle discrepancies up to4.23e-4. Retain exchangeable_joint plus the first histogram head, REPLACE the second head input with64 per-group/action/coarse-age within-bin means weighted by log cell count. This preserves coarse-bin conditioning and centers out a fixed count component without fitted statistics. If exact within-bin ages are useful, fine variants should exceed the active histogram replacement and both sources on validation, with paired-seed repetition. The change also changes scaling and function class, so diagnostics alone cannot establish utility or a causal information effect.

nearest_work.difference: Exact constructor/allocation and first histogram parent retained; replace second input, without adding parameters or a third head. Fresh histogram arm should reproduce the parent function at any shared state dict.

Prior source-style head used count, pooled exponential first/second moments and a derived lower envelope over16 group/action cells. New map uses64 group/action/coarse-age cells with a bounded within-bin age coordinate; no square root/variance subtraction in the new input. Old compact computations remain present for matched execution.

Inherit target-match groups, count/freshness motivation and source-style context modulation, not a new source claim. No learned raw-item IDs or unavailable histories; new bin-conditioned mean replaces oldest-envelope evidence.

Entire field/pooling/histogram/identity/context/repeat/overlap/exchangeable transition representation retained. New within-bin numerical age map can distinguish histories colliding under parent coarse/log2 bins and exact timestamp tie support.

DIN describes target-conditioned learned local activation and weighted pooling. Here exact categorical match strata, fixed numerical bin means and inherited context gating replace learned per-event scoring. This is not DIN reproduction or verified novelty.
Primary README confirms category/brand/type histories without item IDs; no DMR full-paper or exact reproduction claim. Source scope is README only; full publisher paper remains unavailable.

inherited_components: Complete current exchangeable_joint ancestor and every inherited module and initialization.
First compact histogram residual, 68-dimensional context gate, 4256-parameter second head and scratch training.

study.proposed_difference: REPLACEMENT, not another appended head. Four exclusive target category/brand match groups x4 actions x4 frozen coarse age bins gives64 cells. For ages a in finite bin[l,r), u=(log1p(a)-log1p(l))/(log1p(r)-log1p(l)); edges[0,3600,86400,604800] seconds. For last bin u=(a-604800)/a. Clamp numerical u to[0,1]; masked ages sanitized first. For n>0, h=log1p(n)/log129 and m=mean(u). Candidate=h*(2m-1); uncentered=h*m; active control=h; empty/zero arm=0. The algebra centered=2*uncentered-h is exact in real arithmetic; centering is fixed, not statistical orthogonalization, and the candidate can still encode count/support. No claim of new information relative to uncentered+histogram, and no priority claim; external time-encoding literature has not been exhaustively verified. All alternatives execute in every module; only config selects the input.
predictions: Both fine-age features distinguish a fixed same-coarse/log2-bin witness with ages[45000,50000] vs[55000,60000] and identical identities/actions/targets; histogram and parent representations collide. This is an access check, not performance evidence.

New feature tables conserve counts, agree with an independent float64 direct-cell oracle, obey centered=2*uncentered-h, have magnitude<=h, and ignore masked padding and event permutation within floating tolerance. Empty histories/cells produce zero inputs and finite logits.

Primary predictive criterion: full-population validation AUC higher than g0-r0019-fusion_duplicate_histogram and both source bests, with no equal-capacity duplicate explanation. Report Logloss separately; disagreement does not establish a Pareto improvement.

Measured total/dense parameters equal17196083/117395 across four variants (embedding17078688); compare training wall/GPU allocation, examples, memory, throughput and batch p50/p95 against both sources and incumbent. AUC gain alone is not efficiency.
All source seed42 findings are adaptive preliminary local observations; paired seeds43/44 and paired user-cluster uncertainty where host supports it are required for repeated support.

Numerical criterion for new feature diagnostics: independent float64 direct-cell, reversal, padding and affine errors <=1e-5 in float32; count conservation and histogram copies exact on the fixed128-event support. First scalar emulated-float32 attempt failed3e-6, complete7289-case rerun passed1e-5 without model edits; preserve both preparation outcomes. This is a diagnostic tolerance, never a scoring/information contract change.
falsifiers: Either fine variant does not exceed the active histogram arm or stronger frozen source on matched validation, or any gain disappears under paired repetition.

A histogram/zero input creates a fine-age witness gap, direct cell oracle fails above float32 tolerance, count conservation fails, padding changes feature values materially, or logits/diagnostics are nonfinite. Halt interpretation pending correction; failed call remains charged.
Fine variants winning only over zero fails active-capacity attribution; centered winning only over uncentered supports reparameterization sensitivity, not an information gain over that arm.
New input has negligible residual response or near-zero variation on occupied cells: access/optimization may remain unsuccessful; this does not disprove all freshness complementarity.
alternative_explanations: Adaptive validation selection and seed42/checkpoint noise.
Additional active readout access to known histogram information, rather than complementary source evidence; prior duplicate wins are counterevidence that must remain.
Fine-age summary changes feature scale, sparsity and nonlinear function class despite matching parameter allocation.
Parent already has log2 recency and exact time tie support, so gain need not come solely from sub-log2-bin age; only collision witness establishes a possible missing distinction.
Static publisher snapshots have undocumented as-of times; source performance is benchmark evidence, not verified production point-in-time evidence.
Bounds in prior compact input are deterministic moment envelopes with float32 cancellation; they are not observed event extrema. New head avoids their use, but inherited computations are unchanged.
